audit.mapping: source[throttle](durationSelector, { leading: false, trailing: true, restartOnTrailing: false })
audit.note: Adapts audit's duration-next boundary, non-emitting duration completion, source terminal behavior, and cancellation without restarting a duration after a trailing value.

auditTime.mapping: source[throttle](milliseconds, { leading: false, trailing: true, restartOnTrailing: false })
auditTime.note: Numeric duration lifecycle is verified; scheduler arguments are not represented.

buffer.note: Adapts the persistent RxJS 7 closing notifier, completion remainder, error policy, and cancellation lifecycle.

bufferCount.mapping: source[buffer]({ maxSize: bufferSize, startEvery: startBufferEvery ?? bufferSize, emitRemainingOnError: false })
bufferCount.note: Adapts count-sized buffers, including overlapping and gapped startBufferEvery windows, completion partials, and RxJS 7 error behavior.

bufferTime.mapping: source[buffer]({ delay: bufferTimeSpan, maxSize, emitEmpty: true })
bufferTime.note: Multiple concurrent time windows and scheduler arguments are not represented.

bufferWhen.mapping: source[buffer]({ delay: closingSelector, emitEmpty: true, emitRemainingOnError: false })
bufferWhen.note: Uses the unified buffer delay selector and discards the active partial buffer when the source errors.

catchError.note: Replaces source errors with any ObservableValue, preserves caught-source retry identity, and trampolines synchronous retries.

combineLatest.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form; projection overloads remain unrepresented.

combineLatestAll.note: Collects inner sources until outer completion, then delegates combination to the exact static combineLatest Symbol and projection to map.

combineLatestWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified combineLatest Symbol.

concat.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form.

concatAll.note: Flattening is expressed through mergeMap with concurrency one.

concatWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified concat Symbol.

count.note: Counts all values or predicate matches and emits the total only after successful completion.

debounceTime.note: Numeric delays reset a host timer, flush on completion, and cancel via AbortSignal. Scheduler arguments are not represented.

defaultIfEmpty.note: Exact type and lifecycle parity remain test-driven.

distinct.note: Uses Set equality, optional key selection, and an optional flush source that clears remembered keys.

distinctUntilChanged.note: Uses strict equality by default and compares selected keys against the last emitted key.

distinctUntilKeyChanged.note: Delegates property-key comparison to the exact distinctUntilChanged Symbol contract.

elementAt.note: The default-value overload is present; the no-default out-of-range error remains compatibility evidence.

every.note: Evaluates value, index, and source and cancels upstream before emitting the first false result.

endWith.note: Adapts trailing values to one iterable concat source; a trailing SchedulerLike is retained as an explicit unsupported-overload failure.

exhaust.note: Legacy flattening alias maps to exhaustMap.

exhaustMap.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

finalize.note: Runs once after completion, error, or last-observer cancellation without replacing the platform finally method.

filter.note: The RxJS Symbol form preserves predicate index, thisArg, type guards, errors, and cancellation without replacing the platform string method.

find.note: Emits the first matching value or undefined with predicate index, source identity, thisArg, early cancellation, and no replacement of the platform find() Promise consumer.

findIndex.note: Emits the first matching index or -1 with predicate source identity, thisArg, errors, and early cancellation.

flatMap.note: RxJS 7 flatMap is an alias of mergeMap.

first.note: Preserves predicate, default-value arity, EmptyError, early cancellation, and the distinct RxJS Symbol contract without replacing the platform first() Promise consumer.

ignoreElements.note: Maps each input to an ambient empty Observable while retaining source completion and error behavior.

last.note: Preserves predicate, default-value arity, EmptyError, completion-time selection, and the distinct RxJS Symbol contract without replacing the platform last() Promise consumer.

map.note: The RxJS Symbol form preserves projection index, thisArg, errors, and cancellation without replacing the platform string method.

mapTo.note: Expresses constant projection through mergeMap and an ambient single-value Observable.

max.note: Delegates unseeded maximum selection and lifecycle behavior to the exact reduce Symbol.

merge.note: Adapts variadic sources and the numeric concurrency overload.

mergeMap.note: Adapts numeric concurrency; result-selector overloads remain unrepresented.

mergeWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified merge Symbol.

min.note: Delegates unseeded minimum selection and lifecycle behavior to the exact reduce Symbol.

onErrorResumeNext.note: Adapts variadic or single-array source arguments to the current array form.

pluck.note: Traverses one or more string, number, or Symbol keys through the exact map Symbol and returns undefined after a nullish path segment.

race.note: Adapts variadic or single-array sources to the current array form.

raceWith.note: Maps the With variant to the unified race Symbol.

reduce.note: Distinguishes omitted and explicitly undefined seeds and emits accumulated state only on successful completion.

repeat.note: Adapts the legacy numeric count to a config object.

retry.note: Adapts legacy numeric and config inputs while preserving the RxJS 7 resetOnSuccess default.

scan.note: Exact overload and no-seed behavior remain test-driven.

sequenceEqual.note: Supports strict equality by default and the RxJS 7 comparator overload.

single.note: Requires exactly one value or predicate match and preserves RxJS 7 EmptyError, NotFoundError, and SequenceError outcomes.

skip.note: Suppresses the first count values while preserving completion, errors, and cancellation.

skipUntil.note: Subscribes to the notifier first, opens after its first value, ignores notifier-only completion, and cancels both inputs through the shared result lifecycle.

switchMap.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

switchMapTo.note: Legacy result-selector overloads are not represented.

tap.note: Preserves notification side-effect ordering plus subscribe, unsubscribe, and finalize lifecycle hooks.

take.note: Completes after the requested count and cancels upstream through the derived subscriber signal; nonpositive counts do not activate the source.

takeUntil.note: Subscribes to the notifier first, completes on its first value, ignores notifier-only completion, and cancels both inputs through the shared result lifecycle.

takeWhile.note: Normalizes the RxJS 7 inclusive boolean to the RxJS Next configuration form.

timeout.note: Adapts legacy numeric and Date due arguments; scheduler arguments are not represented.

timeoutWith.note: Maps fallback behavior to the unified timeout configuration; scheduler arguments are not represented.

toArray.note: Uses one unbounded buffer and emits it only on successful completion.

withLatestFrom.note: Adapts variadic other sources to the current array form and preserves the optional projection overload.

zipAll.note: Collects inner sources until outer completion, then delegates tuple formation to hardened zip and projection to the exact map Symbol.

zipWith.note: Delegates receiver-first variadic tuple formation to the hardened standalone zip contract.

animationFrames.note: Legacy scheduler arguments are not represented.

combineLatest.note: Adapts variadic sources to an array; projection overloads remain unrepresented.

concat.note: Adapts variadic sources to the current array form; scheduler arguments are not represented.

defer.note: Uses the ambient Observable constructor and defers the factory until subscription.

empty.note: Uses the current EMPTY singleton; the deprecated scheduler overload is not represented.

from.note: Scheduler arguments and the complete RxJS 7 input matrix remain test-driven.

fromEvent.note: Maps EventTarget inputs to the platform when() surface, normalizing boolean capture options; once, unsupported option keys, non-EventTarget inputs, and third- or fourth-argument result-selector overloads fail explicitly.

forkJoin.note: Supports array, object, deprecated rest, empty-input, and result-selector forms while preserving last-value and early-empty cancellation behavior.

iif.note: Expressed as an ambient Observable with subscription-time source selection.

merge.note: Adapts variadic sources and the numeric concurrency overload.

onErrorResumeNext.note: Adapts variadic or single-array source arguments to the current array form.

of.note: Adapts variadic values to the platform Observable.from contract.

partition.note: Returns matching and rejected branches with independent predicate state over the platform source's shared, ref-counted activation.

race.note: Adapts variadic or single-array sources to the current array form.

range.mapping: Observable.from(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => start + i))

throwError.note: Supports factory and legacy direct-error forms; scheduler arguments are not represented.

timer.note: Adapts an absolute Date to a relative delay; scheduler arguments are not represented.

BehaviorSubject.note: Adapts the current factory to the RxJS 7 constructor call shape; lifecycle parity is unverified.

ColdObservable.note: Producer-per-subscription compatibility test surface; not a platform Observable parity claim.

EMPTY.note: Uses the current standalone empty Observable singleton.

EmptyError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible empty-sequence error value.

firstValueFrom.note: Maps Promise conversion to the platform consumer; the RxJS 7 defaultValue configuration is not represented.

identity.note: Uses the public generic identity utility.

lastValueFrom.note: Maps Promise conversion to the platform consumer; the RxJS 7 defaultValue configuration is not represented.

Observable.note: Uses the active native or fallback platform constructor.

NEVER.note: Uses the current standalone never Observable singleton.

NotFoundError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible missing-match error value.

noop.note: Uses the public no-operation callback utility.

ReplaySubject.mapping: new ReplaySubject(bufferSize, windowTime) → replaySubject({ size: bufferSize, maxAge: windowTime })
ReplaySubject.note: Adapts bufferSize and windowTime to the current factory; a third timestamp-provider or scheduler argument fails explicitly, and lifecycle parity is unverified.

SequenceError.note: Uses the public RxJS 7-compatible invalid-sequence error value.

Subject.note: Uses the current exploratory Subject class. Subject.asObservable() returns a distinct non-mutating Observable view without patching the platform Observable prototype.

pipe.note: Adapts RxJS 7 standalone operator composition to the current static pipe Symbol.

zip.note: Adapts variadic and single-array non-projection sources to the current source-array function; projection overloads remain unrepresented.
